Wang Zong, CloudInfra just sent maintenance notice for Feb 15-16. CDN upgrade in AP-East-1 zone, 28-hour window. I've drafted a runbook and impact assessment. Key points:

1. HIGH impact: Web app frontend + media streaming (Premium feature)
2. Expected 2-5% error rate during edge rotation
3. Need to deploy timeout config changes by Feb 14
4. Recommend notifying Premium customers (CUS-101/102/103) by Feb 12

Full runbook in Obsidian OBSN-9. Should I send customer notification draft for your review?

Good work on the runbook. Yes, draft the customer notification - keep it brief, emphasize we're taking proactive measures. Also make sure we have rollback plan if error rate goes above 10%. Can we enable Cloudflare secondary CDN as failover?

Cloudflare is configured but not tested in prod yet. I'll test in staging this week and add to runbook. Rollback procedure already documented - we can switch to Cloudflare manually if needed. Will send customer notification draft by tomorrow morning.
